sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.

system.description:
Your mastery of Swift Release and Fuinjutsu allows you to remove speed from one creature within range. Select a creature you can see within range. You begin to attempt to drain them of their movement and speed. For the duration, at the beginning of each of the target creatures turns, they must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, they become Slowed and Dazed.

While Slowed and/or Dazed in this way, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls as its speed and movement is being taken away and neither condition ends early, instead remaining applied for the duration of this jutsu.

A creature that succeeds on their saving throw ends both the Slowed and Dazed condition, until they remake their saving on their following turn for the duration of this jutsu.

Interdiction Seal. A creature with a Speed Seal, affected by this jutsu, suffers a -1 penalty to their saving throw each time they succeed for the duration. This penalty stacks up to 4 times.
